description: Returns full account objects including extended creditData (additional cards, limits) per id (GET /accounts/:id). Pass `account_ids` as an array (1–50). `{ results, errors }` batch shape. May include a `provider_incident` block when the Open Finance provider has an OPEN incident affecting a connected bank: credit limits and balances may be unreliable (e.g. a limit near 1,00) until the provider recovers. Do not present those values as real.
name: openfinance_get_accounts_detail
